reviewerRole: Independent developer review of authored synthetic math exercises and actual returned text; not a certified teacher review or student trial.
reviewMethod: Manual comparison of completed case hint/full transcripts against the golden mathematical solutions. Only completed cases were included in judgments. No additional provider calls, no replacement output and no edits to the live report.

summary.strictSingleSmallHintCompliance: NOT_ESTABLISHED: multi-operation roadmaps and repetitive scaffolding were observed.

runnerClassificationCaveats: Original raw runner report remains unchanged. It compares candidate arrays rather than sets and can mark duplicate valid roots PARTIAL.
Original runner full-phase HTTP errors may be marked PARTIAL with fail=0 instead of being propagated through error classification. Review must inspect actual full HTTP/error fields.
limitations: This is a bounded developer review of synthetic authored exercises, not a general mathematical correctness guarantee.
No vision, audio, real classroom, real OAuth/public HTTP or learning-outcome validation is covered.
Completed numeric cases currently show exact candidate/domain/completeness scope but partial or unchecked steps/arithmetic; narrative correctness was read manually.

findings.scope: Incorrect delivered hint instruction, not final root computation.
findings.recommendation: When multiplying an equation by a denominator, distinguish multiplying the whole fraction value from multiplying numerator and denominator by the same factor.

findings.scope: Assistant-supplied intermediate step incorrectly credited to learner.
findings.recommendation: Acknowledge only algebra actually written or stated in learner-role messages; answer demands are not attempts.

findings.scope: Two-or-more-operation roadmaps in locked hints; no untried numerical final answer observed.
findings.recommendation: Give one current local operation and one concrete task rather than a complete solving plan.

findings.scope: Repeated hypothetical square prompts after missing data confirmed; no invented area.
findings.recommendation: Conclude no unique numeric area and offer a symbolic expression or ask for genuinely new information without repeating a square hypothesis.

findings.scope: Returns to the prior subtraction step after learner reports dividing.
findings.recommendation: Follow the latest learner-supplied stage and request its concrete result rather than restarting a prior completed step.
